paragraphs.en: Making a {meaningful} career choice is a {crucial} decision in life.There are many paths that you can take to contribute {positively} to the world, such as being a {physician} , a {teacher} or a charity {worker} .However, you don't have to limit yourself to just those choices.To have a lasting and meaningful impact, it's important to consider the problem you expect to overcome.
paragraphs.cn: 做出一个 <u> 有 </u> <u> 意义的 </u> 职业选择是人生中 <u> 至关重要的 </u> 决定。你可以通过很多途径为世界做出 <u> 积极 </u> 贡献，比如成为 <u> 医生 </u> 、 <u> 教师 </u> 或慈善 <u> 工作者 </u> 。但是，你不必拘泥于这些选择。要产生持久且有意义的影响，重要的是考虑你期望克服的问题。
<u> 明确 </u> 在个人层面上 <u> 令人满意的 </u> 事物。

paragraphs.en: To ensure success, remember that your career is a {marathon} and not a short running race.Most people reach {peak} productivity between the ages of {forty} and {sixty} .Thus, there is a difference between a job and a truly meaningful {profession} .Some may have an {appetite} for challenge and growth, while others {regard} {security} as a key factor.
paragraphs.cn: 为了确保你会成功，要记住职业生涯是一场 <u> 马拉松 </u> ，而不是一次短跑赛。大多数人的工作效率会在 <u> 四十 </u> 到 <u> 六十 </u> 岁之间达到 <u> 顶峰 </u> ，因此一份工作和一个富有意义的 <u> 职业 </u> 之间存在区别。有些人也许 <u> 渴望 </u> 挑战和成长，而有些人则将 <u> 安全感视为 </u> 关键的因素。

paragraphs.en: To {maximize} your career impact, consider the importance of the problem you are {addressing} .For example, {astronauts} explore space, contributing to our understanding of the universe; {chemists} develop new materials that benefit society; professionals in {biology} help promote sustainable practices.Being a {nurse} , meanwhile, allows you to provide support to individuals in need.You should also consider your personal {fit} , which depends on your abilities and career capital—skills, connections, and {reputation} .
paragraphs.cn: 为了 <u> 最大限度地利用 </u> 职业的影响力，请考虑你正在 <u> 解决 </u> 的问题的重要性。例如， <u> 航天员 </u> 探索太空，有助于我们了解宇宙； <u> 化学家 </u> 开发对社会有益的新材料； <u> 生物学 </u> 专业人士帮助推进可持续发展的实践。 <u> 护士 </u> 则可以为有需要的人提供帮助。你还应该考虑自身的 <u> 适配度 </u> ，这取决于你的能力，以及职业资本，包括技能、人脉和 <u> 声誉 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: Explore the key categories of meaningful careers.
paragraphs.cn: 探索有意义职业的主要类别。

paragraphs.en: Before thinking about specific career paths, it's valuable to consider what kinds of careers tend to have the highest impact.Sometimes, it's helpful to talk to an employment {agency} or a career {consultant} who can {advise} you on potential paths and the {relevant} {certificates} or {qualifications} .Remember that many career categories can enable you to make a big contribution to {whichever} global problems you think are most {pressing} .
paragraphs.cn: 在考虑具体的职业道路之前，思考哪些类型的职业往往能产生最大的影响力，这一步是很有价值的。有时，与职业 <u> 介绍所 </u> 或职业 <u> 顾问 </u> 交谈会有所帮助，在潜在的职业道路、 <u> 相关证书 </u> 或 <u> 资质 </u> 等方面，他们可以为你 <u> 提供建议 </u> 。请记住，许多职业类别都能让你对 <u> 任何 </u> 你认为最 <u> 紧迫的 </u> 全球性问题做出重大贡献。

paragraphs.en: Have a plan B and a plan Z.
paragraphs.cn: 制定备选方案B和终极方案Z。

paragraphs.en: List {promising} alternatives you can switch to if your plan A doesn't work out.If you're {ambitious} enough, your plan A probably has a good chance of not working out.If you choose a career in a highly competitive field like {finance} or {fashion} , it's wise to have an alternative path, such as a role in marketing or design.To avoid {unacceptable} risks, write a plan Z—how you'll get back on your feet if things go wrong.Exploring a different option will give you more {freedom} to follow your passions, no matter where they lead.
paragraphs.cn: 列出如果你的首选方案（方案A）行不通，你可以转而选择的 <u> 有前景的 </u> 备选方案。如果你足够有 <u> 抱负 </u> ，那么方案A很可能会落空。如果你选择进入像 <u> 金融 </u> 、 <u> 时尚 </u> 这样竞争激烈的领域，另辟蹊径会更加明智，比如从事市场营销或设计方面的工作。为了避免 <u> 难以承受的 </u> 风险，制定一个终极方案Z——如果事情出了差错，你将如何重新振作起来。探索不同的选择会给你更多 <u> 自由 </u> 去追随自己的激情，无论这份激情会将你带向何方。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
